title: Signal IR
description: Canonical intermediate representation for all research signals entering the Content Intelligence Opportunity Engine.

source_platform.description: Specific origin platform or system. Open string — not a closed enum.

source_ref.description: Reference to the originating source item (URL, file path, DB row ID).

extractor.description: Name and version of the Signal Extractor that produced this signal.

signal_type.description: Semantic type of the signal. Extensible — unknown values must not cause errors downstream.

statement.description: Atomic, human-readable claim or observation. One signal, one observation. Max 300 characters.

topic.description: Primary normalized topic. Must be a reusable semantic category, not a description of the source item.

subtopic.description: More precise subject within the topic.

entities.description: Products, people, companies, frameworks, or concepts referenced in the signal.

audience.description: Audience segments this signal applies to.

summary.description: Human-readable explanation of the evidence. Max 1,000 characters.

excerpt.description: Short excerpt preserving original source language. Max 500 characters.

evidence_count.description: Number of source observations supporting this signal.

artifact_ids.description: IDs of content artifacts related to this signal.

frequency.description: Number of times the signal appeared.

engagement.description: Aggregate engagement associated with the signal.

growth_rate.description: Change in frequency or engagement over time.

sample_size.description: Number of observations supporting the calculation.

scores.description: Normalized scores. All values 0.0–1.0. Only confidence is required.

confidence.description: How reliably was the signal extracted? Measures extraction quality, not opportunity quality.

relevance.description: How relevant is this to the creator's content pillars and target audience?

novelty.description: How different is this from existing signals and published content?

urgency.description: How quickly will this signal lose value if not acted on?

observed_at.description: When the underlying signal was observed. ISO 8601.

extracted_at.description: When the Signal IR object was created by the extractor. ISO 8601.

valid_until.description: Optional expiration. Opportunity Engine may penalize expired signals. ISO 8601.

metadata.description: Escape hatch for source-specific fields. Opportunity Engine must not depend on metadata fields.

x-quality-gates.description: Recommended quality gates. Signals below confidence threshold may be stored but must not auto-enter the Opportunity Engine.

x-architectural-invariant: The Opportunity Engine must operate only on Signal IR. It must never read raw source data (Reddit, performance_snapshots rows, Daily Review files, creator exports) directly.

x-versioning.policy: Backward-compatible changes increment minor version (1.x). Breaking changes require new major version (2.0).
